d1_objective: The learner sees pole angle set oscillation frequency and pole radius stretch or reverse the impulse-response envelope, then extends a harmless-looking 100-sample prefix until an unstable mode visibly grows and refutes finite-record stability.

sources.lesson_status: No lesson.mdx exists at preflight time; the lesson author must state the fixed request f*=0.180 cycles/sample and the guided tune-then-extend task beside the embed without changing this numerical contract.

targets.lesson_embed_owned_by_lesson_author: <Demo name="FeedbackStabilityLab" caption="Tune the pole pair to 0.180 cycles/sample under the radius and settling limits, then test the 100-sample stability claim by extending the trace." />

implementation_contract.export: default function FeedbackStabilityLab() with no required props
implementation_contract.client_boundary: Put "use client" before imports because this narrow island owns useState and native input handlers; keep constants and pure recurrence/metric/geometry helpers in the same module and pass no nonserializable props across the boundary.
implementation_contract.lazy_loading: Add the explicit registry import promise only. DemoHost already constructs React.lazy loaders once at module scope and owns Suspense, so do not add next/dynamic, a second Suspense boundary, or ssr:false.
implementation_contract.styling: Use existing Tailwind theme utilities plus currentColor for SVG axes/text and the house amber #e2903a / blue #4c8dd6 with dash/shape cues; add no CSS module, global CSS, inline stylesheet, or chart library.

model.units_and_domain: Normalized frequency f0 is in cycles/sample, 0.05 <= f0 <= 0.45; omega0=2*pi*f0 radians/sample. Radius is 0.900 <= r <= 1.020. The range excludes angles 0 and pi, so the conjugate resonator remains nondegenerate and every 1000-sample endpoint stays finite.
model.input_and_initial_state: x[n]=delta[n]; y[-1]=y[-2]=0. Compute n=0 through N-1 with no resets inside a trace.
model.state_update: Start prev1=y[-1]=0 and prev2=y[-2]=0; for each n, current=(n===0?1:0)+a1*prev1+a2*prev2, append current, then prev2=prev1 and prev1=current.

pole_to_coefficient_mapping.impulse_response_check: h[n]=r^n*sin((n+1)omega0)/sin(omega0) for n>=0, consistent with h[0]=1 and the iterative recurrence. Use the recurrence for rendering to keep state and initial conditions explicit.

model.stability: For this causal rational system, BIBO stable iff both poles satisfy r<1. A finite prefix being numerically bounded is evidence about that prefix only, never proof of absolute summability.

settling.definition: The pole-mode envelope has fallen to at most 1% of its initial envelope.
settling.formula: For 0<r<1, n1pct=ceil(log(0.01)/log(r)); for r>=1, n1pct=Infinity and display 'never'.
settling.important_boundary: r=0.980 gives 228 samples and fails; r=0.970 gives 152 and passes. The continuous boundary for n<200 is r<=exp(log(0.01)/199)=0.977124..., so the 0.001 slider grid's largest passing radius is 0.977.

tuning_target.frequency_pass: frequency_error < 0.01 (below 1%, matching the final design target)

finite_record_falsification.claim: A bounded 100-sample impulse response proves BIBO stability.
finite_record_falsification.counterexample: Set f0=0.180 and r=1.002. Its poles lie outside the unit circle, but max(abs(h[0..99])) is only 1.325583. Extend without resetting state to n=999: max(abs(h[0..999])) becomes 8.004908 and the geometric envelope keeps growing, so the 100-sample observation is falsified.
finite_record_falsification.comparison_metrics: Always calculate max100 from the first 100 samples and maxShown from the selected N. In the extended view show maxShown/max100 and state that r>=1 means no finite settling time and no BIBO stability, independently of visual scale.
finite_record_falsification.honesty: Call the short trace 'bounded over 100 displayed samples', never 'stable'; every finite numeric array is bounded. The recognizable falsification moment requires N=1000, r>=1, and maxShown>2*max100.

derived_only: omega0, a1, a2, conjugate pole coordinates
1000-sample impulse response (slice to N for the chart)
frequency error, stability, n1pct, three target booleans, overall PASS
active system-preset index or null and active trace-length index
max100, maxShown, growth ratio, safe chart scale and SVG points
data_and_state.no_effects: No useEffect, timer, animation, transition, random seed, browser API, memoized external state, or reset between the first 100 and extended samples. All values derive synchronously during render.

initial_state.visible_result: A nonblank damped oscillation and inside-unit-circle pole pair appear immediately. Radius passes, but frequency error is 16.67% and 1% settling is 228 samples, so the view teaches that stable and r<=0.98 do not by themselves meet the transient specification.

interaction.preset_behavior: PresetGroup sets f0 and r; selecting 100-sample trap also returns N to 100 to stage the guided falsification. Compute activeIndex from live f0/r within 1e-9 and leave the trap active when only the view length changes; return null after either system slider moves off a preset.
controls: PresetGroup for the four named system presets, inside a role=group labelled Resonator presets.
Slider 'resonant frequency f0', min 0.05, max 0.45, step 0.001, display in cycles/sample and ariaValueText also giving omega0/pi.
Slider 'pole radius r', min 0.900, max 1.020, step 0.001, display to three decimals and spoken as pole radius.
PresetGroup for 'First 100' and 'Extend to 1000', inside a role=group labelled Trace length; extending continues the same zero-state impulse computation rather than restarting at sample 100.
guided_task: Tune f0 until frequency error is below 1%.
Reduce r until r<=0.98 and n1pct<200; the TargetList and PASS readout confirm all three gates.
Select 100-sample trap and inspect the mild 100-sample prefix.
Select Extend to 1000; the outside-unit-circle poles, rising envelope, max-amplitude ratio, and FALSIFIED readout reject the finite-record claim.
interaction.feedback: At most 1000 two-state recurrence updates plus SVG point mapping run synchronously on each input, comfortably within D2's 200 ms budget and without network activity.

readouts_and_visual.kit_composition: Panel outer container; two PresetGroups; two Sliders; one TargetList for requested frequency, radius, and settling gates; one Readout for coefficients, BIBO verdict, peak comparison, overall PASS, and the explicit FALSIFIED message. Add no UI primitive.
readout_fields: requested/current f0 and relative frequency error
max |h| over first 100, max |h| over shown record, and their ratio
PASS/Not yet for tuning and FALSIFIED/not yet for the finite-record claim
readouts_and_visual.chart: One dependency-free responsive SVG (viewBox about 0 0 480 350, className w-full select-none). The upper inset is a pole plane with labelled Re/Im axes, unit circle, conjugate poles, and textual r/f0. The lower panel is the actual impulse response h[n] with labelled n and h[n] axes, zero line, solid blue response, dashed amber +/-r^n/abs(sin(omega0)) envelopes, a shaded/labelled first-100 region and n=99 boundary when extended, and honest dynamically padded symmetric y ticks derived from finite maxShown. Use all 100 or 1000 points; no chart dependency or animation.
readouts_and_visual.scale_edge_case: Let peak=max(abs(shown)); choose scale=max(1e-9,1.1*peak). If a mapped coordinate is unexpectedly nonfinite, omit the point and force a failing readout, though declared ranges keep all samples finite. Never normalize each segment independently or hide growth by clipping.
readouts_and_visual.non_color_cues: Unit circle dashed versus pole dots; response solid versus envelope dashed; explicit inside/outside, PASS/Not yet, and FALSIFIED labels; first-100 region boundary and peak numbers make every conclusion available without color.
readouts_and_visual.responsive_layout: Stack by default, use sm:grid-cols-2 only for the two sliders, allow kit preset buttons to wrap, and keep the single SVG fluid with no fixed CSS width or horizontal scroll at 360px.
readouts_and_visual.theme: Use currentColor with opacity for axes, ticks, labels, and unit circle; theme classes text-ink/text-soft/text-faint/text-accent/border-line/bg-panel for DOM; verify amber/blue marks plus non-color cues on both light and dark backgrounds.

accessibility.keyboard: PresetGroup uses native Button elements for Tab and Enter/Space; Slider uses native range inputs for Tab and arrow keys; no pointer-only gesture or custom key handler.
accessibility.touch: Existing Button min-h-11 and Slider h-11 provide at least 44px targets; wrapped preset rows and stacked mobile layout prevent crowding.
accessibility.aria: Label both preset groups with role=group; give precise Slider ariaLabel/ariaValueText including units; TargetList and Readout provide polite live text; give the SVG role=img and a concise dynamic aria-label naming f0, r, pole classification, N, max100, maxShown, and whether the claim is falsified.
accessibility.motion: No animation; slider changes replace static geometry immediately, respecting reduced-motion users without special handling.

loc_plan.strategy: Use compact module constants, one recurrence helper, mapped SVG marks, and a single component. Store only f0/r/N. Do not extract runtime files, add a test/chart/math library, use a reducer/effect, or create separate desktop/mobile SVGs.

deterministic_checks: At f0=0.180 and r=0.980, a1=0.8345274115, a2=-0.9604000000, poles have radius 0.98 and angle +/-0.36*pi, frequency error is 0, and n1pct=228; overall tuning fails only the settling gate.
At f0=0.180 and r=0.970, a1=0.8260118256, a2=-0.9409000000, n1pct=152, and all three tuning gates pass.
At the initial f0=0.150 and r=0.980, a1=1.1520590945, a2=-0.9604, frequency error=1/6=16.6667%, radius passes, and settling fails.
For the 100-sample trap f0=0.180 and r=1.002, a1=0.8532617003, a2=-1.0040040000, max100=1.3255831552, max1000=8.0049081806, n1pct=Infinity, and the extended-view falsification condition is true.
Changing only N never changes f0, r, a1, a2, the poles, or the first 100 samples; trace1000.slice(0,100) equals trace100 sample-for-sample.
Strict thresholds: a frequency error exactly 1% fails, n1pct exactly 200 fails, r=0.980 passes the radius gate but not settling, and r=1.000 is not BIBO stable and displays settling 'never'.

All four slider corners at r in {0.900,1.020}, f0 in {0.050,0.450}, N=1000 produce finite coefficients, samples, extrema, and SVG coordinates; the worst declared corner remains around 1.145e9, far below Number.MAX_VALUE.
Preset activeIndex clears after a 0.001 slider move, the Meets all preset yields PASS, and the trap cannot yield tuning PASS even though its frequency matches.
numerical_edge_cases: Use Number.isFinite before formatting settling, ratios, or SVG coordinates; display 'never' for n1pct and an em dash rather than NaN for an undefined ratio.
Never evaluate log(r) for r>=1; classify those radii before the settling formula. The declared r minimum avoids log(0).
Use a 1e-12 radius tolerance only for slider serialization at the <=0.98 gate; do not soften the strict r<1 BIBO test or the strict <1% and <200 task thresholds.
The angle range keeps abs(sin(omega0))>=sin(0.1*pi), preventing a singular analytic envelope. Rendering still uses the recurrence, not division by sin, for the response.
Calculate the full 1000-sample trace once per render and slice it, ensuring the extension is identical state continuation and avoiding inconsistent separately initialized traces.
Use max(1e-9,1.1*peak) for the symmetric y scale so an unexpectedly zero trace cannot divide by zero; x coordinates use N-1 and N is always 100 or 1000.
validation_and_preview: Confirm the component is a default-exported client component, has no required props, imports only React state plus @/components/ui, and is at or below 200 physical lines.
Run a deterministic Node/TypeScript harness for every listed coefficient, trace, threshold, continuation, preset, and endpoint assertion before UI review.
After lesson.mdx exists and embeds the demo, run npm run validate -- digital-signal-processing difference-equations-and-stability.

Run npm run preview -- digital-signal-processing difference-equations-and-stability for static light/dark layout; expect the preview script's nonhydrated demo placeholder, then use npm run dev for interaction.

In npm run dev, inspect the lesson route at desktop and 360px in light and dark themes; keyboard-select all presets and trace lengths, arrow both sliders through endpoints and thresholds, verify active preset clearing, reproduce the numeric checks, and confirm no clipping, horizontal scroll, color-only cue, delayed feedback, or hydration warning.

Guided manual acceptance: use On pitch, slow to observe the separate settling failure, use Meets all to obtain PASS, select 100-sample trap, record max100 near 1.326, extend to 1000, and obtain FALSIFIED with maxShown near 8.005 while the pole plot remains outside the unit circle.

checklist_expectation.D1: PASS: coupled pole geometry, recurrence coefficients, settling, and finite-to-extended growth change together and support both a target and a falsification impossible in one static view.
checklist_expectation.D2: PASS: at most 1000 recurrence updates and SVG mappings are synchronous with no async or network.
checklist_expectation.D3: PASS: the initial ringing state already exposes two failed constraints, and four named system presets anchor the narrative.
checklist_expectation.D4: PASS: the learner can reach an unambiguous three-gate PASS, then a separate FALSIFIED moment by extending the trap without resetting it.
checklist_expectation.D5: PASS by plan: one <=200-line default-exported client component, existing UI imports, zero dependencies, native keyboard/touch controls, and a fluid theme-safe SVG.
